website.rationale: Reviewed homepage selling points, image references and generated-guide sources against the full release range. No homepage claim or public image needs updating; the guide already contains the shipping behavior and will deploy from the release tag. Privacy review baseline c84cf59bfb4ecc3b019b25d44c9552b11fb28225 through candidate ecf1afe4fe7b28cdaad82f4ee7304beda99a6c99: Welcome adds a UI for the existing local crash-prompt preference. It calls the existing native preference setter before enabling update checks; saving does not send a report. Reports still require explicit Send. Appearance and Interface Size persist locally through existing owners. Update-check error separation changes status/recovery presentation, not requests, payloads, destinations or staging/retention. Dock local IPC adds only allowlisted preference actions. No new collection, upload trigger, provider, storage location, retention or deletion rule was found; backend crash-report/feedback/update transports, policy and workflow/service sources are unchanged. No changed service behavior introduces a live-configuration uncertainty. Policy wording and Effective date are retained; this is a source review, not a renewed audit of deployed service configuration.
